item.title: US-based pensioner dies after bee attack at Success; young woman hospitalised
item.description: A 77-year-old woman who was visiting Guyana from the United States has died after she and others were attacked by a swarm of bees at Success, East Coast Demerara, on Friday morning. Dead is Mohadai Sankar, a pensioner of Success, whom police said was staying at her local address at the time of the incident. […]
